This file documents declared operations at the shell, one section per command. Every command is a subcommand of =fx_forward_operation=, and every section exports its own script into =projects/ores.shell/scripts/library/=. Loading a script runs that one command, so a failure names the command it came from.

* Commands

** =publish-fx-forward=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: EADCD5B8-53D6-5B9C-8CE2-FD0A4273DDC1
:END:

Sends =publish_fx_forward_request= and prints =publish_fx_forward_response=, so the shape is the protocol's and the meaning is the service's. It reads =pair_code=, =as_of=, in that order. The caller must have established a session first.


The command is shaped like this:

#+begin_example
fx_forward_operation publish-fx-forward <pair_code> <as_of> [--approval_request_id <v>] [--reason <v>]
#+end_example

It is addressed at =marketdata.v1.ops.publish_fx_forward=.

#+begin_src ores-shell :tangle fx_forward_operation-publish-fx-forward.ores :exports none

#+end_src
